About CounselNexus

Run your entire practice from a single platform

Law firms shouldn’t need a spreadsheet for trust, a diary for court dates, a shared drive for documents and another system for billing. CounselNexus connects them — so your team spends less time on admin and more time on counsel.

One client → many matters → one complete history.

Core modules

Everything your firm needs, connected

Twelve core modules that work as one. Activate what your firm needs today and grow into the rest.

01

Client & Contact Management

A complete profile for every individual, company, trust or estate — with related parties, documents and history.

02

Matter & Case Management

The heart of the firm. Each matter carries its parties, court details, documents, tasks, time and billing.

03

Legal Calendar & Court Diary

Court dates, filing deadlines and prescription dates — with automatic court-day calculations.

04

Trust Accounting

Client and matter trust ledgers, reconciliations and audit-ready reporting with built-in safeguards.

05

Billing & Financials

Hourly, fixed, retainer and contingency billing — from time entry to invoice, statement and receipt.

06

Document Management

A secure digital file for every matter, with versions, templates and fast document generation.

07

Workflow & Tasks

Repeatable task lists per matter type, with owners, due dates, reminders and escalation.

08

Compliance – FICA & POPIA

Client verification, risk ratings, consent and conflict checks managed in one dashboard.

09

Email & Communication

File emails and attachments straight to the matter and see every interaction on one timeline.

10

Client Portal

Give clients a secure place to follow progress, share documents, view invoices and sign.

11

Reporting & Insights

Firm and attorney dashboards showing WIP, collections, utilisation and matter profitability.

12

AI Legal Assistant

Summarise, draft and research with sources shown — always reviewable, never deciding for you.

How it works

From first instruction to final account

  1. Take on the client

    Capture the client once, run the conflict check and complete FICA before work begins.

  2. Open the matter

    Assign the team, set key dates and let the right tasks and documents follow.

  3. Do the work

    Diary, documents, emails and time stay together, so nothing falls through the cracks.

  4. Bill and close

    Turn recorded work into accurate invoices, reconcile trust and close the file cleanly.

Why CounselNexus

Made for South African legal practice

Generic international systems often fall short on local requirements. CounselNexus treats them as part of every matter, not a separate spreadsheet.

Trust accounting

Ledgers, reconciliations and reports designed around local trust account rules.

FICA

POPIA

Prescription & dies

Court-day and prescription tracking so critical dates are never missed.
